prompt: Create a transparent-background contact atlas with exactly two views of this hatch, RIGHT in left cell and LEFT in right cell. Use all four references: the native source and TOP define the handle's physical position; the current RIGHT and LEFT PNGs are the authoritative shape, pixel scale, dimensions, body thickness, colors and line style. Make each corrected side profile retain the current profile's exact approximately 141px wide by 41px tall proportion after normalization: the main frame is a flat shallow band, not a 5:1 long line. This is a careful edit of the two current profiles, not a redesign. Change only where the lifting ring appears along the horizontal frame. In RIGHT, show the ring edge-on near screen-left, on the front-facing end indicated by the source and TOP. In LEFT, show the same small ring edge-on near screen-right, the opposite camera end. Keep both current frame lengths, vertical heights, two square end plates, two warm rivets, dark mottled iron body and warm metal rim. Put the little raised loop just above the frame at the specified endpoint; do not place it centered. The side views remain level axis-aligned orthographic with no visible top plane, no perspective and no isometric angle. Output two separate centered profiles on transparent background with enough gutter; no text, checkerboard, labels, borders, shadows, or extra elements.
